description: Search the VaneUI docs (component pages, guides, usage rules, prop-to-Tailwind mapping). Give a few words or an exact name such as `themeDefaults`. Results are doc sections, best first: sections that hold every word come before sections that hold some, and a word in a heading or page title counts more than one in the text. Returns a JSON array of up to `limit` sections, each with `slug`, `section`, `heading`, `lineNumber` and a short `snippet`, and says when more sections matched than were returned. Pass a result's `slug` and `section` to get_doc to read that section. Use this before guessing prop names, defaults, or class mappings.

limit.description: Most sections to return. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Words or a name to search for (case-insensitive).

regex.description: If true, interpret `query` as a JavaScript regex, matched line by line. Defaults to false (words).

name: search_docs
